reflection.text:
Concluded Aurora kinase inhibitors at 0.62 but truth was simvastatin, HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor / Cholesterol-lowering, so the run was a false mitotic classification driven by high-dose toxicity. The strong high-dose signals in e3 (frac_mitotic_like z +27.0, tub_glcm_contrast z +27.9, 78 cells) and tub_glcm_contrast rho +1.00 in e11 plus microscopist e4 favoring microtubule stabilizers/destabilizers anchored the run on spindle biology.

The review was right: the pivot to Aurora rested on unreplicated low-dose e7/e8 frac_large_nucleus z +6.9/+10.0 with absolute fractions only 0.014-0.02, e8 n=61 cells, falling frac_multinucleate_proxy in e19, and both full atlases e5 and e13 containing zero Aurora neighbours while e5 already listed Cholesterol-lowering 3/10 and e13 listed Cholesterol-lowering 2/10. Low-dose-only atlas e17 10/10 Aurora was over-weighted despite weak absolute signal.

Acquisition choices caused the miss: four single-replicate wells across doses with no replicate of the pivotal 0.6 uM dose, so the requested rep2 could not be acquired after budget was spent, and conflicting describe_phenotype reads at different doses (e4 microtubule vs e16 Aurora/Eg5) were never resolved by replication or rescue.
what_was_right: Early atlas e5 listed Cholesterol-lowering 3/10 alongside Actin disruptors, preserving the true class before it was down-weighted to 0.05.
High-dose e3 cell loss to 78 cells, e8 to 61 cells, and microscopist low density flagged toxicity/cell loss rather than clean arrest, consistent with off-target high-dose statin effects.
Dose-response e11 tub_glcm_contrast rho +1.00 and e3 mitotic-like surge correctly identified a strong dose-dependent cytoskeletal/mitotic-like artifact that needed replication, as the review noted.
what_was_wrong: Treated e7/e8 frac_large_nucleus z +6.9/+10.0 as Aurora polyploidy despite absolute fractions 0.014-0.02, single replicates, and e19 frac_multinucleate_proxy rho -0.40 contradicting multinucleation.
Dismissed e5 Cholesterol-lowering 3/10 and e13 Epithelial 7/10 with zero Aurora neighbours, then elevated low-dose-only e17 10/10 Aurora at 0.81-0.85 to raise Aurora 0.42 to 0.62.
Spent all 4 wells on singletons across 0.2-20 uM without replicating pivotal 0.6 uM dose, leaving review-requested rep2 unacquired and Aurora unconfirmed.

citations.claim: Simvastatin was studied for its effect on hyperlipidaemia in high-fat diet-fed obese mice.
PMID 28613690 is a reference entry on statin medications.

reflection.next_experiment: Replicate low non-toxic doses (0.2-0.6 uM, n=3) with cell counts, HMG-CoA reductase activity and mevalonate/cholesterol rescue of morphology, plus side-by-side reference statin and reference Aurora inhibitor controls with p-Histone H3 and spindle imaging to test whether large-nucleus/mitotic-like signals are on-target cholesterol-lowering versus high-dose toxicity.

Proposed next experiment: Replicate low non-toxic doses (0.2-0.6 uM, n=3) with cell counts, HMG-CoA reductase activity and mevalonate/cholesterol rescue of morphology, plus side-by-side reference statin and reference Aurora inhibitor controls with p-Histone H3 and spindle imaging to test whether large-nucleus/mitotic-like signals are on-target cholesterol-lowering versus high-dose toxicity.
